name: zsnd_sample_set_registry_get_count
description: zSnd sample-set registry count and indexed lookup helpers return the active registry size and valid entries, with null for invalid lookups.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 profile vc5_o2_ob2_md_facs produced symbol @zSndSampleSetRegistry_GetByIndex@4 with zero unmasked byte mismatches for 0x4a08d0 after COFF relocation masking (8 relocation bytes, 9 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed; BN size 39, VC size 48).

VC5SP3 profile vc5_o2_ob2_md_facs produced symbol _zSndSampleSetRegistry_GetCount with zero unmasked byte mismatches for 0x4a0900 after COFF relocation masking (8 relocation bytes, 8 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed; BN size 24, VC size 32).
VC5SP3 profile vc5_o2_ob2_md_facs produced data symbol _g_zSnd_SampleSetRegistry with zero unmasked data-byte mismatches for 0x56b290 (16 bytes).
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4a0900 validates returning zero when registry begin is null, otherwise returning (end - begin) / sizeof(zSndSampleSet *).
Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4a08d0 validates returning null for negative index, null registry, or index >= count, and returning begin[index] for a valid index.
The native smoke verifies count, valid indexed lookups, out-of-range lookup, negative lookup, name lookup, and missing-name lookup against a two-entry registry.
